description: This file contains the implementation of a journaled grain called 'AccountGrain' in Orleans that models a bank account with event sourcing capabilities. It includes state management, deposit, withdrawal, and retrieval of transaction logs, as well as a variant class that disables full event sourcing.

classes.name: AccountGrain
classes.description: A journaled grain implementing a bank account with event sourcing for deposit and withdrawal operations.

classes.name: AccountGrain.GrainState
classes.description: Represents the current balance state of the account, with methods to apply deposit and withdrawal transactions.

classes.name: AccountGrain_PersistStateOnly
classes.description: A subclass of AccountGrain that does not persist the event log, only the latest state.

methods.name: Balance
methods.description: Returns the current balance of the account.

methods.name: Deposit
methods.description: Handles deposit transactions by raising an event with deposit details.

methods.name: Withdraw
methods.description: Attempts to withdraw an amount; raises an event if sufficient balance exists.

methods.name: GetTransactionLog
methods.description: Retrieves the list of confirmed transactions from the event log.
